issue.title: Add an agent_runners chop guard and idle-gate bugyi_chop_ci_watch
issue.description: A declarative `inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: N}}` chop guard exists end to end, and `bugyi_chop_ci_watch` uses it so the chop only runs while no SASE agent holds a runner slot.

issue.title: Rust agent_runners guard provider
issue.description: core-guard: add the `agent_runners` guard variant, the `holds_runner_slot` agent snapshot field, the decision and validation logic, and config-authority acceptance in `../sase-core`.

issue.title: Host snapshot, schema, and docs for agent_runners
issue.description: host-guard: teach the Python preflight host to build runner-slot agent snapshots for the new provider, accept it in `sase.schema.json`, document it, and cover it with tests including count parity.

issue.title: Guard skips stop consuming run_every cadence
issue.description: guard-cadence: stop advancing a chop's `run_every` clock when the skip came from an `inhibit_if` guard rather than from the configured trigger, so a guarded chop retries on the next tick.

issue.title: Enable the idle guard on bugyi_chop_ci_watch
issue.description: ci-watch-idle: add `inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: 0}}` to the `ci_watch` chop in the chezmoi-managed config, refresh its description body, and verify the live runtime accepts and honors it.

payload.entry: Added the agent_runners guard variant to sase-core: wire.rs (ChopGuardConfigWire::AgentRunners{max}, ChopAgentSnapshotWire.holds_runner_slot), decision.rs (skip when active+holds_runner_slot count exceeds max, naming an offending agent; earlier guards still short-circuit first), config.rs (agent_runners allowed in validate_guard_provider with max validated via existing validate_nonnegative_integer, both keyed/tagged spellings, unknown_guard_provider message updated). Added decision + config-validation tests in axe_chop/tests.rs and a python-binding round-trip test in sase_core_py/src/lib.rs. Verified with 'just check' from the sase-core repo root (full workspace build, clippy, fmt, and test suite, including the sase_core_py binding tests) - all green. Committed and pushed to sase-core master as a0a6ca4.

Implemented: added ChopRunOutcome.advances_cadence (default True); record_preflight_outcome in chop_runner_policy.py sets it False only when status=skipped and preflight.decision.provider is not a trigger provider (always/git.commits_since); Lumberjack._outcome_to_result gates update_timestamp on outcome.advances_cadence in addition to run_every being set. Documented behavior change in docs/axe.md. Added two tests: guard skip does not advance cadence, git.commits_since trigger skip still advances cadence. Verified via 'just check' (all lint gates + scoped test lane, 193/2562 files) after 'just install' rebuilt the Rust core binding — all green, exit 0.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Refresh reproducible flake baseline — just check-full fails in selection-health because seven reproducible flakes exceed tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt after the test-cost lane passes.

Implemented host agent_runners snapshots/schema/docs/tests; verified targeted pytest and terminology audit passed; just check-full passed through test-cost but failed selection-health flake baseline on seven unrelated reproducible flakes, with follow-up noted.

Implemented host-side agent_runners chop preflight support; verified just install, targeted pytest for chop preflight/schema automation/terminology audit, terminology audit, and just check-full through test-cost; check-full then failed only selection-health flake-baseline entries recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP.

Added inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: 0}} to ci_watch in chezmoi's sase_athena.yml, refreshed its description, and committed+applied via chezmoi update -a --force. Verified live: sase axe chop doctor was OK with the guard wired (provenance chezmoi overlay) only after upgrading the installed sase-core-rs 0.26.5->0.26.6 (published core-guard support the local tool hadn't picked up yet, within the existing >=0.26.5,<0.27.0 pin); before the upgrade doctor correctly failed closed with unknown_guard_provider. sase axe chop run ci_watch executed normally with the machine idle, and -f/--force is available to bypass the guard for manual runs.

VERIFIED all four phases end to end.

CORE (sase-ko.1, sase-core a0a6ca4, shipped in sase-core-rs 0.26.6): ChopGuardConfigWire::AgentRunners{max} and ChopAgentSnapshotWire.holds_runner_slot (serde default) in wire.rs, skip decision in decision.rs, agent_runners accepted with a validated non-negative max in config.rs, plus decision/config tests and a python-binding round trip. Confirmed the commit and CHANGELOG entry in the linked checkout; pyproject's sase-core-rs floor stays 0.26.5 by design (release-owned per docs/rust_backend.md, enforced by release-core-floor-smoke), so no pin edit was needed.

HOST (sase-ko.2, 7e8f528b2): evaluate_chop_preflight now builds agent snapshots for agent_runners, and _agent_snapshots(guards) emits holds_runner_slot only when an agent_runners guard is configured, keeping the deny_unknown_fields wire byte-identical for older cores. Both inhibit_if blocks in sase.schema.json (chop and lumberjack-chop) gained agent_runners in the tagged provider enum and keyed propertyNames plus a max: integer>=0 constraint; docs/axe.md and docs/configuration.md name all four providers, the runner-slot population, the max default, the STARTING/question-parked exclusions, and the manual-run -f/--force escape hatch. patch_stitch_audit's legacy-enum allowance was widened for the new enum line. Tests cover skip/fire/force, the omitted-field guarantee, and count parity against running_root_agent_count.

CADENCE (sase-ko.3, e5b0b5f5c): ChopRunOutcome.advances_cadence, derived in record_preflight_outcome from _TRIGGER_PROVIDERS={always, git.commits_since}, gates Lumberjack._outcome_to_result's update_timestamp. Audited every ChopPreflight construction site: only chop_policy's engine-backed path returns outcome='skip', and it always carries a decision with a provider, so no skip can silently land on a None provider; the directly constructed preflights are all check_error and keep prior cadence behavior.

CI-WATCH (sase-ko.4, chezmoi 54de26c3): ci_watch carries inhibit_if: {agent_runners: {max: 0}} with a refreshed description body.

LIVE VERIFICATION from this workspace on the real config and real agent state: sase axe chop doctor is clean; the chop inventory shows inhibit_if=[{provider: agent_runners, max: 0}] with chezmoi overlay provenance down to inhibit_if.agent_runners.max. With 8 live agents of which 2 held runner slots, evaluate_chop_preflight returned skip for both scheduled and manual runs with the engine reason 'inhibited by 2 agents holding runner slots (e.g. ...); max is 0' and provider=agent_runners, while force returned fire. The five WAITING agents correctly did not count. Targeted suites (test_axe_chop_preflight_policy, test_config_schema_automation, test_axe_lumberjack_config_parsing, test_patch_stitch_terminology_audit) pass: 71 passed.

INTEGRATION: reviewed everything committed since the epic started. In sase: 4381a90bb (docs refresh) and 6439dc99c (ACE state-init split) landed mid-epic and 37a3545cd (bead query render split) landed on origin/master; none touch chop guards, and the epic's own docs commit landed after the docs refresh so no provider enumeration is stale. In sase-core: only release commit 475cd27. In chezmoi: nothing after the epic's own commit. Swept the repo for other guard-provider enumerations (chop_render, chop_doctor, chop_inventory, _config_targets._normalize_guards, the ACE axe entry editor) - all are provider-generic and need no change. The plan's non-goals (ci_watch's in-script ci_fix hood suppression, the %w(runners=0) gate prompt) were correctly left alone.

FOLLOW-UPS: sase-ko.2's only PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (refresh the reproducible-flake baseline) reproduces - just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake exits 1 on 7 nodes - but is not epic-caused: all 7 pass in isolation (74 passed in 22.69s) and none touch AXE. No new task was created because every node is already tracked; recorded +1 corroboration on sase-jq (the five test_core_vcs_log nodes, and the test_contract_manifest node its description already attributes to sase-iu) and on sase-kd (test_creation_budget_defers_then_converges_next_pass).
